integrity: Universal argument uses a published Type-A intersection lemma, explicit context counting and an eleven-state integer polynomial identity; three standalone standard-library verification programs check its separate ingredients. Finite enumeration is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result describes the induced two-read deletion ambiguity graph on linear 010-free binary words and exactly counts its edges and zero-degree vertices at every length. It does not give an all-length closed expression for the maximum reconstruction-code size or extend to other edit channels. Historical priority beyond inspected available literature is not guaranteed.
title: Exact two-read deletion ambiguity and isolated-word spectrum in `010`-free binary words
